newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area on Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test, USDA said.
Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 3,600 head slaughter steers and 1,200 heifers; 69,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 24,700 formulated and 3,100 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs
65.00. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb Holsteins 59.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs
65.00. Select and Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs, including heiferettes 61.00-62.00.
